michael: Morning — espresso pulse (quick async). What I did: synced with AE on Aurora, pushed perf numbers for Dedicated sizing. Blockers: enterprise security still needs HSM BYOK timeline for Aurora; legal has redlines on the pilot SOW. Today: follow up with security + push sizing doc to NovaHealth demo queue.

lena: Ack. For NovaHealth demo I can prep the Dedicated capacity estimate by EOD. Need the expected qps and SLA target from sales.

carlos: FYI Aurora security ask — they want HSM key wrapping details and audit logs sample. Legal sent redlines here: https://rwd.internal/links/aurora-sow-redlines. Can someone loop in security and CSM?

priya: Looping in security now. Quick proposal: if BYOK timing slips, offer a BYOK staging plan with temporary KMS keys + HSM cutover timeline. Also tagging fallback model for low-latency demo:
```
rollout:
  canary: 10%
  fallback: "redwood/latency-slim-v1"
```
I'll draft the staging plan and share in the channel.

michael: Thanks @priya — if you can include audit-log samples that satisfy Aurora's infosec checklist that would speed approval.

lena: Q on PRs — who can review routing-policy PR #482? small change but affects canary routing. @carlos ?

carlos: I can take a look this morning, pinging now.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: Canary deployment started for redwood/latency-slim-v1 (canary=10%). CI passed. :rocket:

priya: Quick note for SRE: Phoenix region capacity is constrained next week — if NovaHealth needs Dedicated for demo, we should propose EU fallback or guaranteed reserved slot.

michael: Good call. I'll ask sales to confirm region preference. If no reply by 3pm, we'll propose EU fallback. :thumbsup:

lena: Today items for me: capacity estimate, demo checklist, and runbook snippet for fallback. Will post links when ready.

michael: Perfect. Blocker owners: @priya security, @carlos legal review, @lena capacity. I'll consolidate updates before EOD and update the customer thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:
